errorCodes.meaning: The VTA holds no record of this identity, or the caller cannot reach its context.

DidClass.description: The DID class an identity was created in (VTI specification, DID classes, VTI-KEY-190 – 193), fixed for its life. `relationship`: an identifier for one relationship, one community or one trust context. `persona`: a person's own identity. `service`: the durable identity of a node or a service.
DidClass.title: DidClass

DidMethodName.description: The DID method an identity uses, as the method profile that governs it is named: `webvh` for a did:webvh identity, `scid:vh` for the did:scid:vh:1 form of one, `webs` for did:webs. Deliberately a pattern and not an enumeration: a method is added by publishing its profile under method-profiles/, never by changing this schema. A VTA MUST refuse a method it holds no profile for, or whose profile declares it ineligible, with `vta/dids:methodNotEligible`.
DidMethodName.title: DidMethodName

DidSummary.description: One identity the VTA holds, as every method has it, with what only its method has under `methodDetails`. CONVENTIONS.md §20.3.

alsoKnownAs.description: Other identifiers the identity is published as: a did:scid identity's other form, a did:webs identity's did:web and did:keri forms. Empty where there are none.

class.description: The DID class the identity was created in. Absent where none was recorded; a VTA never infers one.

contextId.description: The context the identity belongs to. Absent for an identity in no context, which only an unrestricted caller sees.

createdAt.description: When the VTA created or adopted the identity.

deactivated.description: Whether the identity has been ended. It still resolves, as deactivated.

did.description: The identity, in the form it is presented in. A did:scid:vh:1 identity is presented in its did:scid form or its did:webvh form, and the other is in `alsoKnownAs`.

keyAgreementKeyId.description: The VTA's id for the identity's current key agreement key. Absent where it has none.

label.description: The VTA's own label for the identity. Not published.

level.description: The identity's key assurance level. `1` for every identity that is not a key-role identity.

method.description: The method profile that governs the identity: `webvh`, `scid:vh`, `webs`, `key`.

methodDetails.description: What only the identity's method has, as one member named by its `method`, defined by that method profile's Summary details (CONVENTIONS.md §18). Absent where the profile defines none. A consumer ignores a member it does not recognise.

primary.description: Whether the identity is its context's own DID.

serverId.description: The VTA's id for the hosting server the identity is published through. Absent where it is published through none: a serverless did:webvh, a did:key.

signingKeyId.description: The VTA's id for the key the identity currently signs with — what a caller names to have the VTA sign as it. Absent where it has none.

updatedAt.description: When the VTA last changed its record of the identity.

DidSummary.title: DidSummary

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

KeyAssuranceLevel.description: A service DID's key assurance level (VTI-KEY-194; CONVENTIONS.md §3.4). `1` — single key: no `keyRoles`, one key signs everything. `2` — role-separated: `keyRoles`, with the `attestation` and `update` keys held by the VTA, which may derive them and back them up. `3` — recoverable: level 2 with those keys generated and in no backup, a recovery key held by a recovery custodian outside the VTA, and a witness enforcing it. Declared in the document's `keyAssurance` member.
KeyAssuranceLevel.title: KeyAssuranceLevel

did.description: The identity to summarise. Either form of a did:scid:vh:1 identity.
